paite: TOUPA khut ka tung ah a-om a, TOUPA kha in ahon pikhia a, phaizang laitak ah hon koih a; guh ngen in huai phaizang adim hi.
heading: Guh Keu Phaizang

paite: Huan alak uah ahon pi vialvial a; phaizang ah guh tampi ana om lemlom a; ngai dih, akeu ngen ahi.
Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte ahing thei diam?" achi hi. Ke'n, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, nang na theizaw hi," ka chi hi.
Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Thu gen inla, akiang uah, 'Aw, nou guh keute aw, TOUPA thu ngai un.
Hiai guhte kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, noute ah nakna ka lutsak ding a, na hing ding uh.
Noute ah thagui ka koih ding a, sa in ka hon tuam ding a, vun in ka hon khuh ding; huan na sung uah nakna ka omsak ding a, na hing ding ua, kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh,' chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka genta a; ka gen leh husa ahong om a, ngai in, aging luilui a, guhte amau kizoppih chiat ah akisutuah khawmta uh.
Ka etleh ngai in, amau ah thagui ahong om a, sa in atuam a, vun in akhuhta a; nakna bel amau ah a-om nai kei hi.

Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Huih kiang ah thu gen inla, mihing tapa, gen mahmah in, huih kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nakna, kawlmong li a kipan in hong pai inla, hiai mithahte tung ah nak in, ahintheihna ding un, chi in," achi hi.
Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka gen a, amau ah nakna ahong lut a, ahingta ua, amau khe chiat in ahong dingh ua, sepaihhon thupitak ahong hita hi.
Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte Israel inkote pumpi ahi ua; ngai dih, amau, 'Ka guhte uh akeu khin in, ka lamet uh abei khinta, phukmang in ka omta uh,' achi uhi.

Huaiziak in thu gen inla, akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ahante uh ka hong ding a, aw, ka mite aw, na han ua kipan ka hon khah ding a; huchi in Israel gam ah ka hon pilut ding hi.
Na hante uh ka hon a, na han ua kipan ka hon pawtsak hun chiang in, aw, ka mite aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Huan noumau ah ka Kha ka koih ding a, na hing ding uh, na gam ngei uah ka hon koih ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita a, ka hih lai ding ahi chih na thei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi," achi hi.
Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel, Lalgam Khat Ah

paite: Nang, mihing tapa, chiang khat la inla, atung ah, "Judah leh akithuahpih Israel suante," chih gelh in; chiang dang leng la inla, atung ah, "Joseph leh Ephraim chiang leh akithuahpih Israel inkote tengteng," chih gelh in.
Huan chiangte peh inla, na khut a khat ahihtheihna ding in.
"Hiaite bang chihna ahi ua, na hon kawkmuh kei dia hia?" Na nam tate un na kiang ahon chih uleh, akiang uah,

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Ephraim leh akithuahpih Israel chite khut a om Joseph chiang ka la ding a, huaite Judah chiang toh ka peh ding a, khat in ka bawl ding a, ka khut ah khat ahong hi ding, na chi ding hi.
Chiang, atung a na gelhnate mahmah amitmuh ngei uah na khut ah a-om ding hi.
Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ava tunna gam ua namte lak a kipan Israel tate ka pikhe ding a, ning chih a kipan ka kaikhawm ding a, agam uah ka pikik ding hi.
Huan huai gam, Israel tangte ah nam khat in ka bawl ding a, kumpipa khat avek ua kumpipa ahi dia; huan, nam nih ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vaihawmna gam nih in leng akikhen nawn sam kei ding hi.

Amilimte uh, athilkihhuaite uh, atatleknate un leng akihihnin ngei nawnta kei ding ua; apuk ua akhelhna nak tengteng ua kipan ka hunkhe ding a, ka khuahsiang ding; huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
Ka nasempa David atung ua kumpipa ahi ding a, avek ua tung ah belamchingtu khat a-om ding; ka thupiakte amang ding ua, ka dan bawlte azui ding ua, azang ding uh.

Ka nasempa Jakob kiang a ka gam piak, na pipute uh na tenna sek ah ateng ding ua; huai ah tangtawn in ateng ding ua, amau leh atate uh, atate uh tate leng; ka nasempa David tangtawn in aheutu uh ahi ding hi.

Huai lou leng amau kiang ah lemna thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau a ding in tangtawn thukhun ahi ding a, akiang uah ka pe ding a, amau ka pungsak ding a, alak uah tangtawn in ka biakbuk ka dingsak ding hi.
Ka biakbuk leng akiang uah a-om ding a, a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh.
Huan alak ua tangtawn a ding a ka biakbuk adin hun chiang in kei TOUPA, Israel hihsiangthoupa ka hi chih namte'n athei ding uh, achi, chi in.
